newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Forekspank dominates dull day on Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Forekspank dominates dull day on Estonian bourse.

text.p: Forekspank dominated trading on what dealers called a slow day on the Estonian stock market.
"It was a day for Forekspank shares, which took a third of the total volume of the market" said one dealer.
The Tallinn stock exchange index fell 0.9 percent to 186.01 on a turnover of 39.2 million kroons on the official list.
Forkespank accounted for the bulk of the trade with a volume of 16.6 million kroons to close up 0.96 kroons at 144.25.
"Forekspank has been a good buy. There were some larger blocks this morning and the trade continued" said one trader.
Savings Bank was down 1.35 to close at 86.00 kroons on turnover of five million kroons.
Also attracting interest was Tallinna Pank with 9.1 million shares traded to end weaker at 64.84 kroons, 0.31 lower.
Elsewhere on the market, Hansapank was lightly traded with only 3.8 million kroons of shares sold to finish at 175.05, down 0.70 kroons.
"The market has not recovered from the shock of the big blocks that dominated trade yesterday" said one dealer.
Over-the-counter trade was light with only 6.7 million kroons changing hands.
The market was led by Rakvere meat plant with a turnover of 5.6 million kroons to close trading on 15.50 kroons up 0.80 kroons.
"While Rakvere continues to move up analysts are sceptical about the company and are waiting the company's results due in February" said one trader.
Also on the OTC market, Kalev Confectionery was down 25 kroons to close at 1,475 kroons but with only light trading of 1.1 million kroons.
